status: What the ontology lacks to answer evals/dev/artwork-lifecycle/proposed_items.json. Sources are named, never read here; 'source unknown' carries the question that would find one.

gaps.name: ArtworkVersion / Proof (an exact proof attachment version with its approval status and approver)
gaps.ontology_today: No curated artwork or proof type; only the generated not_served types RelPublicAppAttachment and RelPublicAppArtworkVersionDecision.

gaps.name: CustomerApproval (customer sign-off on one exact proof version, channel and reference, recorder kept apart)
gaps.ontology_today: No customer-approval object; MCApproval and the not_served RelPublicAppApprovalRecord are generic and carry no proof-version binding.

gaps.name: QA artwork acceptance and Regulatory review, with the gate strength in force
gaps.ontology_today: No QA-acceptance or regulatory-review object; the soft-gate rule exists only as Portal code paths, and no source of the deployed gate setting is known.

sources.relation: soft-gate code path (approval with a warning)

gaps.open_question: Is the artwork QA gate deployed on staging/UAT as a soft warning with a waiver or as a block, where is that setting held, and does accepting artwork for an unreleased formula warn or block?

gaps.name: Printed-component lineage (proof version -> minted P-item -> previous item with held lots -> FG revision)
gaps.ontology_today: FgItem and the served app_product exist, but no link from a proof version to its P-item, to the item it replaced, or to the FG revision that froze it.

gaps.name: Artwork version on PO line, receipt line and incoming QC
gaps.ontology_today: PurchaseOrderLine and ReceiptLine exist, but the reporting API serves them without artwork_attachment_id / artwork_version, and app_incoming_qc_record is not served.

sources.relation: allowlist columns of app_purchase_order_line and app_receipt_line

gaps.name: AO label reconciliation (Form #013B lines, QA sign-off, in-process inspection #010, release acknowledgement)
gaps.ontology_today: AssemblyOrder exists, but no label-reconciliation, sign-off or release-acknowledgement object; only the generated not_served types RelPublicAppAoLabelReconciliationLine, RelPublicAppAoLabelVerificationSignoff and RelPublicAppAoQcReleaseAck.

gaps.name: Portal artwork and label relations through the reporting API
gaps.ontology_today: None of app_attachment, app_artwork_version_*, app_approval_record, app_ao_label_* or app_ao_qc_release_ack is an approved relation, so no record is readable.

gaps.name: Artwork version to formula / ingredient-list basis
gaps.ontology_today: No link from an artwork version to the formula version and ingredient list it was checked against; only the generated not_served RelPublicAppArtworkVersionBasis.

gaps.name: Portal P-item to FileMaker packaging and BC item identity
gaps.ontology_today: No crosswalk from a Portal-minted P-item to a FileMaker packaging id or a BC item; the map reports new P-items cannot flow through FileMaker-resolved receiving, reorder and AO paths.
gaps.open_question: Which record maps a Portal-minted P-item to its FileMaker packaging id during cutover, and is app_bc_entity_map populated for printed-component items?

gaps.name: BC AO component consumption of printed labels
gaps.ontology_today: The GET-only BC grammar serves items and itemLedgerEntries but names no assembly-order entity set, so AO consumption of a label lot is unreadable as such.
gaps.open_question: After cutover, which BC record holds AO consumption of a printed label lot (assembly orders, production order consumption or item ledger entries), and in which company?

gaps.name: Digital Form #008 capture
gaps.ontology_today: The map's target captures Forms #013B, #010 and #008; Portal has tables for #013B and #010, and no #008 table was found.
gaps.open_question: What does Form #008 record on an AO, and where is it captured today (paper, FileMaker or a Portal table)?

gaps.name: Open question from the Artwork Handoff cases: artwork-department owner
gaps.ontology_today: Not in the ontology; named by the handoff request, whose originals are unread here (read receipt pending).
gaps.open_question: Who owns the artwork department decision on a proof (a named role or person), and where is that owner recorded?

gaps.name: Open question from the Artwork Handoff cases: die-line owner
gaps.ontology_today: Not in the ontology; named by the handoff request, whose originals are unread here (read receipt pending).
gaps.open_question: Who owns the die-line for a printed component, and where is its version held?

gaps.name: Open question from the Artwork Handoff cases: legacy proof attachment
gaps.ontology_today: Not in the ontology; named by the handoff request, whose originals are unread here (read receipt pending).
gaps.open_question: How is a proof attached before the Portal (email, FileMaker or SharePoint), and which record links it to its printed component?

gaps.name: Open question from the Artwork Handoff cases: print-ready artifacts
gaps.ontology_today: Not in the ontology; named by the handoff request, whose originals are unread here (read receipt pending).
gaps.open_question: Which print-ready artifacts go to the printer for an approved version, and where are they stored?
